title: Order of the error event and the pointer advance is not defined in resource selection
body:
In the *children* branch of the [resource selection algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-media-load-algorithm), step 10 queues a task to fire `error` at the failed candidate, and step 11 then [awaits a stable state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#await-a-stable-state). The synchronous section that follows advances the pointer, selects the next candidate, and sets `currentSrc`.

Step 10 queues a task and step 11 queues a microtask, both from steps running in parallel. If the event loop is running a task at that point, the microtask checkpoint at the end of it runs the synchronous section before the `error` task. If the event loop is idle, the `error` task may be selected first. Both orders seem allowed.

This is observable as `currentSrc` inside the `error` handler.

[demo](https://software.hixie.ch/utilities/js/live-dom-viewer/?%3C!DOCTYPE%20html%3E%0A%3Cscript%3E%0Afunction%20cur%28%29%20%7B%0A%20%20return%20document.getElementById%28'v'%29.currentSrc.split%28'%2F'%29.pop%28%29%20%7C%7C%20'%22%22'%3B%0A%7D%0A%3C%2Fscript%3E%0A%3Cvideo%20id%3D%22v%22%3E%3Csource%20src%3D%22delayed-image%3F1%22%20onerror%3D%22w%28'error%20on%20source%201%3A%20currentSrc%20%3D%20'%20%2B%20cur%28%29%29%22%3E%3Csource%20src%3D%22delayed-image%3F2%22%20onerror%3D%22w%28'error%20on%20source%202%3A%20currentSrc%20%3D%20'%20%2B%20cur%28%29%29%22%3E%3C%2Fvideo%3E%0A): two `source` elements that both fail, logging `currentSrc` from each one's `onerror`.

| | `currentSrc` at source 1's `error` |
|---|---|
| Firefox Nightly | `delayed-image?2`, pointer already advanced |
| Chrome Canary | `delayed-image?1`, not yet advanced |
| Safari TP | `delayed-image?1`, not yet advanced |

Should the `error` event be dispatched before or after the pointer advances?

(Noticed while investigating #12835.)
